name: foxlake-vehicles
note: Remakes of the Fox Plains built-in vehicles that were still simple low-poly bodies (the sedan, coupe, pickup, heavy-duty truck and Maple Hauler already draw from Meshy scans). Text-to-3D smart topology (meshy-t2.5) previews, textured with refine, then cleaned in Blender by modules-src/foxlake/tools/build-vehicles.py to the built-in's body extents, +x forward, with wheel pivots at the axles.

helicopter.note: Life Sim's Kestrel Two-Seat Helicopter; cut into body, rotor-main and rotor-tail by modules-src/foxlake/tools/build-helicopter.py (download to .meshy-cache/helicopter.glb first)

bubble-helicopter.model: nano-banana-2-1 design image, then meshy-t2.5 smart topology (16k) + meshy-n1
bubble-helicopter.note: Life Sim's Bumblebee Bubble Helicopter; download to .meshy-cache/bubble-helicopter.glb, then build-helicopter.py -- bubble. A first text-to-3D try (01a1e1f2-1504-..., 15 credits) closed the bubble and boom and was not used.
